name: Cece
author: ure
description: Cece, a Burmilla cat that chases your cursor across the desktop: a Rust port of the classic neko. From the bar icon you can mute it, make it stay, or let it out.

barWidget.description: Click to mute or unmute the cat, right click to make it stay put or follow, middle click to let it out or send it away.

schema.label: Speed
schema.description: How fast the cat runs. 2 is the classic pace.

schema.label: Skin
schema.description: burmilla, classic, or a path to a sprite sheet PNG.

schema.label: Quiet
schema.description: No yawns, snores or startled meows.
